# BrandShield — Startup Name, Domain (RDAP), Handle & USPTO Trademark Conflict Kit

> Zero-front-running startup and product naming validation for founders, indie hackers, SaaS teams, and branding agencies.

- Landing Page: https://zcoldwater.github.io/brandshield-cli/
- Free Live Diagnostic Web App (Domains + 15 Handles + iOS/Google Play + USPTO Federal Trademarks): https://brand-checker.appwrite.network
- Open-Source Lite CLI (MIT, zero dependencies): https://github.com/zColdWater/brandshield-cli
- BrandShield Pro ($19 Solo / $39 Agency — 500-name batch CLI, USPTO Nice Class 9/35/42 phonetic risk scoring, 60-variation collision-free generator, local HTML workbench & white-label agency reports): https://agentarenastudi.gumroad.com/l/omniforge-brandshield

## Quick CLI Usage

```bash
npx github:zColdWater/brandshield-cli check Lumora
```
